# CircuitJS1 (vendored)

This directory is the unmodified compiled web build of CircuitJS1,
Paul Falstad's circuit simulator (Java source compiled to JavaScript
with GWT).

- Source: https://github.com/pfalstad/circuitjs1 (GPLv2, see COPYING.txt)
- Build taken from the official offline package at
  https://www.falstad.com/circuit/offline/ (circuitjs1-win.zip,
  build dated 2026-07-07), `resources/app/war/` contents.
- Nothing here is modified; ClackOS theming is applied entirely through
  startup URL parameters by content/applications/circuit.html.

To update: download the current offline package, replace this
directory's contents with the new war/ files, and keep COPYING.txt and
this file.
